scope.description: This read-only check verifies remote immutable Git trees and small metadata against the upload manifests and source catalog. Chunk payload SHA-256 values and volume hashes were checked during upload; this check compares those recorded hashes and remote Git blob identifiers. It does not download the 168 GB TXT payloads again, compute a new global original SHA-256, or verify a Lean proof. Release/ref state is an observation, not a lock against later user changes.
